real_world.use: Opened from inside, the plug door is drawn in out of its frame, turned edgewise through the opening and swung out on its hinge arms until it lies flat against the outside of the fuselage.
real_world.note: The hinge arms are hidden behind the door's lining; what shows is the door's path.
